items.title: Rain halts Hong Kong semifinal clash between Alexandra Eala and Maria Sakkari
items.detail: The Hong Kong Tennis Open semifinal between Alexandra Eala and Maria Sakkari was suspended due to rain with Sakkari leading 5-2 in the second set.

items.title: Kalyn Ponga Returns to Kiwis 19-Man Squad for Rugby League World Cup Semifinal

items.title: Luka Doncic Routs Portland With 53 Points, Ties Michael Jordan Milestone

items.title: Luka Doncic Storms Back To Power Lakers Past Portland Trail Blazers

items.title: SASSA issues critical review warning ahead of December 2026 grant payments
